items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I had the good fortune of

ctx.x: Well, he was a fabulous piano player that lived back in the '20s, and he lived in Houston, Texas, and people would come from all over the country. He was just a fabulous piano player. And the old story was yeah, but you can't get him to leave town. He had offers from Paul Whiteman, no, he wouldn't leave. He stayed. I had the good fortune of

hearing him play. It was just fantastic. Of course the old school of piano, the full stride, Art Tatum type things, and in other words, the piano player in that school of piano, they had to sound like a whole band. They played their own accompaniment and the band and the solos and everything, but he was absolutely fabulous, but he would not leave Houston, Texas. And that's Turk Van Lake. I mean he would not leave New York.
